description.value: Zinc Bar is a historic bar and jazz club in Greenwich Village. It occupies the famous space at 82 W 3rd street once known as the Cinderella Club where Billie Holiday performed. Posted hours run late, with Friday 5 pm - 2 am, so it suits a late night. Restaurantji shows 4.1 300 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “We immediately fell in love with the romantic Art-Deco-era Paris jazz bar vibe”; “Really friendly staff and good cocktails”. Representative watch-outs: “I wish they had different snacks for the folks who can't/don't want flat bread”; “Get there early for your choice of seat”.
